_comment: Copy and locale metadata for the static link-preview pages (scripts/gen-seo-pages.mjs). Only what the app's own catalogs do not carry lives here: the messengers' locale codes, the brand name, the card texts. Page titles come from src/i18n/<locale>.json, indicator descriptions from seo/indicator-descriptions.json.
_baseUrl_comment: Where this instance is reachable from the outside; it is baked into canonical/hreflang/og:url and sitemap.xml by scripts/gen-seo-pages.mjs. Set SEO_BASE_URL when building for a real domain and leave this default for local work.
_ogLocale_comment: Open Graph wants a locale_Country form (the language alone is accepted but the spec's form is this one).
_descriptionLimit_comment: Every messenger shows og:description in two or three lines and cuts longer text without an ellipsis, so the generator cuts it on a word boundary itself.
_alt_comment: og:image:alt of the indicator card, the card of the catalog and the landing (a picture a screen reader and a failed load fall back to).
